name: The Ashwick Ferry — Landing (Original Placeholder)
ambient: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER AREA) A gravel landing above black water. The ferry bell hangs silent under a tarred shed, and the skiff is pulled up where the last crossing should have returned.

npcs.name: Maela Vey
npcs.look: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER NPC) A ferrywoman in a patched oilskin stands with her back to the water. She keeps looking toward the boathouse and does not let go of the bell rope.

npcs.name: Ferry Bell
npcs.look: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) A bronze bell under a tarred hood. The clapper is gone; a shallow bronze socket waits beneath the rope. The notice still says: RING ONCE FOR PASSAGE. RING TWICE FOR THE DEAD.

objects.name: Ferry Notice
objects.look: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER OBJECT) A nailed-up notice, faded by spray: THE ASHWICK FERRY CROSSES AT FIRST LIGHT. RING ONCE FOR PASSAGE. RING TWICE FOR THE DEAD.

interactions.label: Read the ferry notice
interactions.success_text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) The second line has been scratched over and written again. Someone wanted the warning remembered.

effects.text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) Beyond the landing, the boathouse windows are dark. The bell rope is still knotted where it was cut.

objects.name: Moored Skiff
objects.look: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER OBJECT) A shallow skiff, pulled hard against the landing. A second mooring ring waits across the water at the boathouse.

interactions.label: Take the skiff to the boathouse
interactions.success_text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER) You cast off and row across the black water. The oars make no sound.

entry_effects.text: (ORIGINAL PLACEHOLDER CAMPAIGN) The Ashwick ferry has not crossed in three days. The landing is empty except for Maela Vey and the bell that will not ring.
